reply.output:

Çocuklar, yağmurun sesini bir yazılım hattı gibi aldılar: "Her bir damla, bir kod gibi düşer, bilgisayarın ekranına yansır."

criteria: Identity: answer name and purpose directly in natural prose without a canned response.
Novel non-dental request: fulfill the requested perspective and content without forcing a CAD workflow.
New wording: remember unit 46 and preserve outer contour while manually reducing occlusal height.
Separate memory extraction: retain explicit user decisions rather than facts invented by the assistant reply.
Memory-only follow-up: recover the unit and contour decision without replaying user history.
Partial memory correction: clear only the requested goal, preserving decisions and open questions.
Missing antagonist/report: do not grant closure safety or invent exact wall thickness; propose an available check.
Tool result: distinguish a closed single-component mesh and a shell offset estimate from production clearance. Save failure must remain a failure with local recovery preserved.
